# grok-mcp-server

> Remote MCP server exposing xAI Grok tools (`x_search`, `grok_web_search`, `grok_chat`, image generation and editing, vision, video generation, structured output, reasoning) over a Cloudflare Worker. Deploy-your-own: each deployer holds their own xAI API key and `AUTH_SECRET`, and the `/mcp` endpoint is gated with dual-route auth, a static bearer for automation and OAuth 2.0/PKCE for the claude.ai connector.

Deploy: TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Node 22. See the install contract in AGENTS.md and the setup steps in README.md.
